title: A white scaffold sheet with a mark inset on it
why: The ordinary case, and the one the widening rule is visible in: the mark spans x 10–17, and the box is x 9–18 because a downscale can shave a partially-covered edge pixel. At this size the sampling scale is 1, so nothing is shaved and the widening is pure margin — which is the point, since the rule must not depend on whether it was needed.
